document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You see a vision, where the world begins to tilt violently. Tidal 
waves smash against every coast, obliterating every city and town. 
The polar ice caps melt, while a permanent freeze grips what were 
once the middle latitudes. Floods, snow, panic, and death follow. 
For most of mankind, it is the end. But for other creatures, it is 
a new beginning. Return to 426. 
(426)
